word_translation_en: to tie; to knot; to establish
sentence_example_translation_en: We want to establish new contacts.
typical_collocations: Kontakte knüpfen; Freundschaften knüpfen; Beziehungen knüpfen; ein Netz knüpfen
usage_comments_en: While its literal meaning is to tie knots (e.g., in carpets or threads), 'knüpfen' is extremely common in modern German in metaphorical contexts, especially with 'Kontakte' (contacts), 'Beziehungen' (relations), or 'Freundschaften' (friendships), meaning 'to forge' or 'to establish'.

typical_collocations: ein handgeknüpfter Teppich; echter handgeknüpfter Orientteppich; handgeknüpfte Ware
usage_comments_en: An adjective primarily used to describe high-quality carpets (often Persian or oriental rugs) or tapestries made by tying individual knots by hand, as opposed to machine-made products.

sentence_example: Die Decke ist eine feine Knüpfarbeit.
sentence_example_translation_en: The blanket is a fine piece of knotting work.
sentence_synonym: Die Decke ist eine feine Handarbeit.
typical_collocations: mühsame Knüpfarbeit; kunstvolle Knüpfarbeit; Knüpfarbeit lernen; Knüpfarbeit machen
usage_comments_en: Refers to either the process or the resulting product of knotting (like macrame, carpets, or rugs). It often connotes meticulous and time-consuming handcrafting.

sentence_example: Der Knüpfer arbeitet seit Monaten an dem Teppich.
sentence_example_translation_en: The knotter has been working on the carpet for months.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Ткач ковров работает над этим ковром уже несколько месяцев.
sentence_synonym: Der Teppichknüpfer arbeitet seit Monaten an dem Teppich.
typical_collocations: erfahrener Knüpfer; traditioneller Knüpfer; die Arbeit des Knüpfers
usage_comments_en: An agent noun referring to a person whose job or craft is to knot carpets, nets, or tapestries. Often found in historical descriptions or texts about traditional industries.

sentence_example: Die orientalische Knüpfkunst erfordert viel Geduld.
sentence_example_translation_en: Oriental knotting art requires a lot of patience.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Восточное искусство плетения ковров требует много терпения.
sentence_synonym: Die orientalische Knüpftechnik erfordert viel Geduld.
typical_collocations: traditionelle Knüpfkunst; orientalische Knüpfkunst; die Knüpfkunst beherrschen; alte Knüpfkunst
usage_comments_en: A cultural term referring to the skilled craftsmanship of tying knots to create complex visual patterns in rugs, carpets, or wall hangings. Usually used in historical, artistic, or tourist contexts.

sentence_example_translation_en: They bought a valuable knotted carpet.
typical_collocations: handgearbeiteter Knüpfteppich; persischer Knüpfteppich; wertvoller Knüpfteppich; Knüpfteppich reinigen
usage_comments_en: Specifically designates a carpet made by tying yarn onto a warp, contrasting with woven (Webteppich) or tufted carpets.

sentence_example: Die Knüpfung engerer Beziehungen ist notwendig.
sentence_example_translation_en: The establishment of closer relations is necessary.
sentence_synonym: Die Herstellung engerer Beziehungen ist notwendig.
typical_collocations: Knüpfung von Kontakten; Knüpfung sozialer Bande; dichte Knüpfung (bei Teppichen)
usage_comments_en: The nominal form of 'knüpfen'. In carpet manufacturing, it refers to the density or style of the knots (e.g., 'feine Knüpfung'). In abstract contexts, it refers to initiating or forging social/professional ties.

word_translation_en: to untie; to detach; to squeeze out (money/secrets)
sentence_example: Er wollte mir mein letztes Geld abknüpfen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He wanted to squeeze my last money out of me.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он хотел выманить у меня последние деньги.
sentence_synonym: Er wollte mir mein letztes Geld abluchsen.
typical_collocations: jemandem Geld abknüpfen; ein Versprechen abknüpfen; ein Geheimnis abknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A separable verb. Literally, it means to untie or detach something. Figuratively (and very commonly), 'jemandem etwas abknüpfen' means to craftily or persistently get money, a promise, or information out of someone.

word_translation_en: to build on; to connect; to resume; to establish
sentence_example: Wir möchten an die gestrige Diskussion anknüpfen.
sentence_example_translation_en: We would like to build on yesterday's discussion.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Мы хотели бы продолжить вчерашнюю дискуссию (отталкиваться от нее).
sentence_synonym: Wir möchten an die gestrige Diskussion anschließen.
typical_collocations: an eine Tradition anknüpfen; an den Erfolg anknüpfen; Kontakte anknüpfen; Gespräche anknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A highly versatile separable verb. It is very frequently used with the preposition 'an' + accusative to mean 'to refer back to', 'to resume', or 'to build on' (e.g., 'an ein Thema anknüpfen'). When used transitively, it means to establish (e.g., 'Kontakte anknüpfen').

sentence_example: Der Gefangene wurde am Galgen aufgeknüpft.
sentence_example_translation_en: The prisoner was hanged on the gallows.
sentence_synonym: Der Gefangene wurde am Galgen erhängt.
typical_collocations: einen Knoten aufknüpfen; jemanden am Baum aufknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A separable verb. It has two completely different meanings. 1. (harmless) To undo or untie a knot or lace (e.g., 'die Schuhe aufknüpfen'). 2. (drastic/grim) To execute someone by hanging (mostly colloquial/historical, with a negative, harsh tone).

word_translation_en: to tie in; to knot in; to weave in
sentence_example: Sie müssen den Faden hier einknüpfen.
sentence_example_translation_en: You need to tie the thread in here.
sentence_synonym: Sie müssen den Faden hier einarbeiten.
typical_collocations: einen Faden einknüpfen; Perlen einknüpfen; Muster einknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A separable verb. Mostly used in textile work (such as weaving, knitting, or making carpets/macrame) to describe incorporating a thread, yarn, or decorative element into an existing piece of fabric or work.

word_translation_en: to link; to combine; to associate
sentence_example: Diese beiden Themen lassen sich eng verknüpfen.
sentence_example_translation_en: These two topics can be closely linked.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Эти две темы можно тесно связать друг с другом.
sentence_synonym: Diese beiden Themen lassen sich eng verbinden.
typical_collocations: eng verknüpft sein mit; Daten verknüpfen; Theorie und Praxis verknüpfen; Schicksale verknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A very common verb in formal and logical contexts. It describes connecting abstract ideas, data, causes, or fates. Typically constructed with the preposition 'mit' + dative ('A mit B verknüpfen').

word_translation_en: to tie up; to button up
sentence_example: Kannst du mir bitte die Jacke zuknüpfen?
sentence_example_translation_en: Can you please button up my jacket?
sentence_synonym: Kannst du mir bitte die Jacke schließen?
typical_collocations: die Jacke zuknüpfen; den Mantel zuknüpfen; den Sack zuknüpfen; die Schnürsenkel zuknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A separable verb meaning to close something using strings, knots, or buttons. Although 'zuknöpfen' specifically means buttoning, 'zuknüpfen' is often used interchangeably in everyday language for fastening coats, bags, or strings.

word_translation_en: to tie together; to knot together
sentence_example: Er knüpfte die beiden Seile fest zusammen.
sentence_example_translation_en: He tied the two ropes tightly together.
sentence_example_translation_ru: Он крепко связал обе веревки вместе.
sentence_synonym: Er band die beiden Seile fest zusammen.
typical_collocations: zwei Enden zusammenknüpfen; die Fäden zusammenknüpfen; Seile zusammenknüpfen
usage_comments_en: A separable verb. It literally means to join the ends of two or more ropes, strings, or threads by tying a knot, thereby creating one continuous piece.
